description: This source file defines an in-memory, thread-safe implementation of a product repository for a backend application. It provides methods to add, retrieve, update, and delete products, using a concurrent dictionary to manage products safely in a multi-threaded environment. The class initializes with some sample products and implements the IProductRepository interface.

classes.name: InMemoryProductRepository
classes.description: A thread-safe in-memory repository for managing Product objects. Implements add, get, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: InMemoryProductRepository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with some sample products.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Returns all products ordered by their Id.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its Id, or null if not found.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new product, assigning it a unique Id.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a product by its Id, returning true if successful.
